heading: For every kind of builder.
description: Helix fits the way you already work — solo, in a team, or across an enterprise org.

items.title: Ship features, not diffs.
items.description: Stop reviewing 2,000-line AI PRs. Focus on the change that matters.

Smaller PRs, faster reviews, happier teams.
Spend time on design — not on diffs.

items.title: Predictable AI delivery.

outcomes: Fewer late-night hotfixes from sprawling AI diffs.
Demo day without a fire drill.

items.title: Governance, by construction.
